The collector's discovery and hasBundle checks incorrectly expected `final-review-ID.diff`. Both now recognize the actual `final-review-ID.md.diff` filename. allReviewedPassages.interpretation: Producer-shaped archive/idempotence/conflict/null/no-work fixture behavior described, not agent/live acceptance.
allReviewedPassages.rawText: The fixture now uses that producer filename. Added behavior checks prove that completion inventories it, repeated collection preserves exact bytes and records, an archive conflict returns 3 without overwriting either archive or source, and repair permits completion. A null/no-work result with only that direct package returns 3, archives the available bytes, records both reconciliation and missing-review gaps, and remains idempotently gapped on replay. Existing interrupted-copy, split-input, source-workspace-removal, immutable source/extraction, retained finding and other gap cases still pass. The new assertions catch an omitted package/inventory, incorrect complete result, overwritten source/destination bytes, lost reconciliation/missing-review gaps, or non-idempotent records; none depend on source-text matching.

allReviewedPassages.interpretation: Sandbox logging denial/inside-root guard refusal are setup failures; completed tests claim no leak.
allReviewedPassages.rawText: No leaked processes were found after RED, GREEN script, or contract-lint runs: each completed outside-root `stop-run-processes --check` exited 0 with no output. The final `stop-run-processes` stop also exited 0 with no output; no match or survived lines occurred, and no background process was started. The first RED launch could not redirect its log under the sandbox and did not execute tests; the authorized escalation then produced the RED evidence above. An initial leak check from inside the target worktree returned its protective exit 2; rerunning from outside the task roots returned 0 with no output. All completed test runs use the prescribed isolated temp state. No agents were spawned and no Herdr writes were made.
